name: Optimal Layer-wise QP Offset Derivation
definition: A method to optimize bit allocation across RAHT layers by minimizing a Lagrangian cost function that balances distortion and bitrate, using analytical solutions for QP offsets.
summary: Optimal Layer-wise QP Offset Derivation analytically calculates quantization parameters for point cloud compression by minimizing a Lagrangian cost function, differing from heuristics by deriving offsets from fitted empirical models.
